v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Cor contrítum * et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
text.en: A contrite and a humbled heart, * O God, thou wilt not despise.

text.la: Propter nomen tuum, * Dómine, vivificábis me in æquitáte tua.
text.en: For thy name's sake, * O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

text.la: Deus, tu convérsus * vivificábis nos, et plebs tua lætábitur in te.
text.en: Thou wilt turn, O God, * Thou wilt quicken us and bring us to life.

text.la: Cum irátus fúeris, * Dómine, misericórdiæ recordáberis.
text.en: When thou art angry, * O Lord, thou wilt remember mercy.

text.la: Lauda * Deum tuum, Sion, qui annúntiat iudícia sua Israël.
text.en: Praise thy God, * O Sion, who declareth his judgments to Israel.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: Cum facis * eleemósynam nésciat sinístra tua quid fáciat déxtera tua.
text.en: When thou dost * alms, let not thy left hand know what thy right hand doth.

text.la: Inchoáta ieiúnia, quǽsumus, Dómine, benígno favóre proséquere: ut observántiam, quam corporáliter exhibémus, méntibus étiam sincéris exercére valeámus.
text.en: Further with thy gracious favor, we beseech thee, O Lord, the fasts which we have begun, that we may be able to practice the bodily fasts which we keep, with sincere minds.
